tasks.title: Plant a Tree in Ward 8 / Your Neighborhood
tasks.description: Find a suitable spot. Plant one native tree or shrub. Photo proof: before (hole dug) + after (planted). GPS pin optional but appreciated.

tasks.title: Cuyahoga River Cleanup (or nearest waterway)
tasks.description: Collect trash/debris from riverbank or shoreline for 1 hour. Photo proof: before + after + filled bag(s).

tasks.title: Remove Invasive Plants (per sq meter)
tasks.description: Remove invasive species (garlic mustard, phragmites, etc.) from a natural area. Photo proof: before + after + species identified.

tasks.title: Wellness Check on Isolated Neighbor
tasks.description: With consent: visit or call an isolated/elderly person in your area. Chat for 15+ minutes. Fill out a simple 5-question wellbeing form. Their privacy is protected — no names shared.

tasks.title: Food Bank / Pantry Volunteer Shift (2 hours)
tasks.description: Volunteer at a local food bank, community fridge, or mutual aid pantry. Photo proof at location + confirmation from site coordinator.

tasks.title: Mutual Aid Delivery (local area)
tasks.description: Pick up supplies from a mutual aid hub and deliver to 1-3 recipients. Photo proof: pickup + delivery confirmation from recipient.

tasks.title: AI Training Data Labeling (per batch of 50)
tasks.description: Label a batch of 50 images or text snippets for SolarPunk's AI training. Instructions provided. Takes about 20 minutes. Done in browser.

tasks.title: Community Survey (humanitarian research)
tasks.description: Complete a 10-15 minute survey about community needs, resources, or local conditions. Anonymous. Your data helps target resources better.

tasks.title: Translate SolarPunk Content (per 500 words)
tasks.description: Translate SolarPunk guides/art descriptions into your native language. Arabic, Spanish, French, Swahili, etc. all needed. Quality reviewed by AI + community.

tasks.title: Verify Another Worker's Completed Task
tasks.description: Review photo proof submitted by another worker. Answer 3 questions: Is the task clearly completed? Any concerns? Approve/flag. Takes 2-3 minutes.

tasks.title: Submit Art for Gaza Rose Gallery
tasks.description: Create and submit one piece of digital art (any style) related to: Palestine, nature, SolarPunk, community, healing, hope. If selected: listed on Gumroad, 30% to artist, 70% of that 30% to you directly.

tasks.title: Photo Document Your Community for SolarPunk Archive
tasks.description: Take 10+ photos of your neighborhood, nature, community life. Added to SolarPunk's public archive. You retain credit. We build collective memory.

tasks.title: Submit grant: awesome_foundation_READY
tasks.description: Review and submit the completed grant application at data\grant_submissions\awesome_foundation_READY.md.

tasks.title: Research 5 orgs for SolarPunk outreach
tasks.description: Find contact emails, current projects, and alignment with SolarPunk's mission for the next outreach batch.

tasks.title: Test new engine: MCP_CLIENT
tasks.description: Run and verify output of MCP_CLIENT.py — report any errors.
